answer: Stake-weighted attestations block Sybils: a vote counts only after a bond is locked and peers that are themselves staked and established attest to it. A farmer can mint endless wallets, but each identity needs its own bond and independent sponsors, so scaling multiplies real cost. Each credential is a lantern lit only by capital; shared pigment across clones shows up when their attestation graph fuses into one cluster; and a regular pulse of re-attestation makes rented reputations expire unless paid for again, keeping recurring attack cost above any one-time payout.
